statement: (let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let L := fun n : ℕ => max 1 (Nat.log 2 n / 2); let K := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (L n), Real.cos (2*Real.pi*(2:ℝ)^(j+1)*t))/(L n:ℝ); let o := fun n q : ℕ => q % 2 = 1 ∧ ((Finset.Icc 1 ((Nat.log 2 (Q n)+1)^2)).filter (fun j => q ∣ 2^j-1)).Nonempty; ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, (∑ q ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 ((Q n)^2)).filter (fun q => o n q), min (1:ℝ) ((q:ℝ)/(Q n:ℝ)) * (((Finset.range (q+1)).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q ∧ (1:ℝ)/3 < K n ((a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)))).card:ℝ) / (Nat.totient q:ℝ)^2) ≤ ε) → (let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let L := fun n : ℕ => max 1 (Nat.log 2 n / 2); let K := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (L n), Real.cos (2*Real.pi*(2:ℝ)^(j+1)*t))/(L n:ℝ); let o := fun n q : ℕ => q % 2 = 1 ∧ ((Finset.Icc 1 ((Nat.log 2 (Q n)+1)^2)).filter (fun j => q ∣ 2^j-1)).Nonempty; ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, (∑ q ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 ((Q n)^2)).filter (fun q => ¬ o n q), min (1:ℝ) ((q:ℝ)/(Q n:ℝ)) * (((Finset.range (q+1)).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q ∧ (1:ℝ)/3 < K n ((a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)))).card:ℝ) / (Nat.totient q:ℝ)^2) ≤ ε) → (let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let L := fun n : ℕ => max 1 (Nat.log 2 n / 2); let K := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (L n), Real.cos (2*Real.pi*(2:ℝ)^(j+1)*t))/(L n:ℝ); let B := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | t ∉ arcs n ∧ (1:ℝ)/2 < K n t}; let G := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => ∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ((Q n)^2), ∑ a ∈ (Finset.range (q+1)).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q), 4*(n:ℝ)^2 / ((Nat.totient q:ℝ)^2 * (1+((n:ℝ)*(t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)))^2)); let m := fun (s : Set ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) => intervalIntegral (s.indicator f) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, m (B n) (G n) ≤ ε*(n:ℝ))

plain_statement.zh: 由两类离散中心计数推出整个模型质量界
plain_statement.en: Recover total model mass from two discrete center counts

brief.zh: 将两个分母族的加权计数相加。近场的非零贡献要求中心处 K>1/3，单峰代价至多 8πn min(1,q/Q)/φ(q)²；其余收费归入已经控制的远尾。
brief.en: Sum the two weighted counts. A contributing near field requires K>1/3 at its center, costing at most 8πn min(1,q/Q)/φ(q)² per center. The remaining contributions are covered by the proved far-tail estimate.
